name: Benchback
status: planned; awaiting Lens Studio account sign-in

theme.palette: warm white, amber source, teal tray, coral attention

assets.name: BenchbackMarkers
assets.description: Code-authored 6 cm source and tray ring markers with a distinct grip silhouette; animated connector follows saved locations. Intended as spatial annotations, not physical part replicas.

assets.name: BenchbackRecord
assets.description: Quiet 80ms confirmation for a committed spatial record

assets.name: BenchbackReturn
assets.description: Short soft cue when a part group is reconciled

assets.name: BenchbackAttention
assets.description: Restrained attention cue for an invalid or out-of-order action

labels: Mark source. Mark tray. Record the group.
Drag amber to the source; teal to the tray.

stateOwnership: BenchbackState is the sole owner of ledger, draft metadata, counts, phase, selection and undo history. UI is passive.
pipeline: Generate planned assets through CLAD skills; bootstrap semantic roots with VirtualScene; compile and inspect actual native preview; run each LEAF scenario separately.
verification: See test-plan.md. No Benchback tests have been run yet.
publication: Keep existing main until replacement works. Preserve old project in Git history. Do not submit the hackathon entry.
limits: User-marked positions and counts; no camera recognition or installation verification
Session-local state; no cross-restart persistence claim
Physical-glasses comfort and anchor accuracy unproven
